expectationBasis: The repository overview identifies a seeded public repository in a visible heading, displays a “Public” marker, and provides a navigation link “Code” distinct from the clone-menu Code button.
The overview displays a heading containing `acme-docs`, a visible “Public” marker, and a “Code” navigation link.
The system pre-provisions public repository `acme-docs` in organization `Acme Demo`; the visitor can open its overview without signing in.
After the visitor reloads the page, the `acme-docs` repository heading remains visible.
The public repository is readable without sign-in and retains its heading after reload.
